issues.description: Column identifier mismatch for the same concept: the problem text asks for the column 'ID' to be returned (task description at line 108 in problem_statement.md) and additionally gives a general instruction not to rename columns using AS (line 102). The solution query instead uses an alias for the same column (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql line 1: 'SELECT id AS Kennung, ...'), renaming 'id' to 'Kennung'. A student reading the task expects the column to appear as 'id' (and is explicitly instructed not to use AS), so the solution's use of the alias 'Kennung' creates an identifier naming inconsistency and may confuse students or cause automated checks that validate column names to appear inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the identifier names: either remove the alias in the solution so the column is returned with its original name (change solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql line 1 to: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad') or, if the alias 'Kennung' is deliberate, update the problem statement to explicitly permit or require the alias 'Kennung' and remove the blanket instruction forbidding AS for this task.
